1.note: Read as a year from Creation (3,000 + 402); likewise ג"א תנ"ב, תס"ז, תקמ"א below.

2.note: Printed תקב"ג, which is not a regular numeral (image checked); probably תקכ"ג = 3523.

3.note: The verse with מבין וסופר (David's uncle Jonathan) is 1 Chronicles 27:32.

4.note: Print has מקורות ('sources'); read as קורות, 'the events of his journey'.

5.note: Kept as printed (the second letter is blurred, ח or ה); the Sabbath-trading verse is Amos 8:5.

6.note: Kept as printed (נ"ה or נ"ח, blurred); the verse 'nor pursuing your business' is Isaiah 58:13.

7.note: Kept as printed; the tithe to the Levites is Numbers 18:21.

8.note: Read as the year 3544 of the creation era (ג"א = 3000), like (ג"א ת"ב) on p. 46.

9.note: Kept as printed; the saying is Avot 1:1.

10.note: Kept as printed; the verse is 2 Chronicles 32:32.

11.note: Kept as printed; the verse is 1 Chronicles 21:1.

12.note: Second letter blurred in the print (כ or נ); read פכ"ג, chapter 23.

13.note: The chapter letter looks like ה in the print; read ח (Numbers 8:24).

14.note: Kept as printed; 'from thirty years old to fifty' is Numbers 4:3 (and 4:23 ff.).

15.note: The first word is smudged in the print; read והספר.

16.note: Abbreviation left unexpanded; perhaps R. Isaiah Pick (Berlin), glossator of the Talmud.

17.note: The verse is Nehemiah 10:32; Weiss counts Nehemiah with the book of Ezra.
